messages:
sara-support: Heads-up — GarageLabs (dedicated pool ga-3, us-west2) opened a ticket: steady 429s and tail latency spikes since ~08:30 PST. They say it correlates with recent long-context batch runs.
ops-bot: [alert] DedicatedPool ga-3: high 429 rate (5m avg 12/min) — KV eviction surge detected.
alex-sre: Can you paste the minimal repro or curl they used? Also which model variant?
sara-support: Sending their repro snippet below — customer runs many keep-alive sessions with ~50k token contexts in bursts.
```bash
# simplified repro (customer)
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
    -d '{"model":"open-65b-stream","context":50000,"prompt":"<large prompt>"}' &
done
```
ingrid-runtime: I pulled eviction logs for nodes backing ga-3 — saw repeated slab compaction cycles and high free-list churn. Sample from node ga-3-12:
```
[kvcache] eviction: rate=472/s window=60s
[kvcache] slab_compact start ts=2840123201 region=0 target=0.6
[kvcache] heap_frag: before=1.9GB after=1.6GB freed=320MB
[kvcache] alloc_fail: attempts=4
```
mike-ml: Customer model is large + using very long prefix keys; kv keys balloon because they don't use prefix pruning. Combined with variable seq lengths this -> fragmentation. Also their request pattern creates many short-lived large caches.
alex-sre: Repro confirmed on staging: when we replay their script against a 4-GPU dedicated pool we see eviction spikes and auth throttles (429) as request queues back up. Key symptoms: high kv eviction rate, compaction cycles, latency SLO breach.
tian-account: Customer is asking if this is billable. They ran into degraded throughput — please advise what we can tell them while we debug.
ingrid-runtime: Short-term mitigation options:
- ask customer to reduce max_context to 32k or split sessions
- enable tenant-level kv cap: `kv.max_entries_per_tenant=500k` (temp)
- trigger immediate slab compaction on affected hosts: `/admin/kv/compact?node=ga-3-12` (ops only)
- route tenant to a larger reserved queue (burst capacity) if available

alex-sre: I can push a canary: tweak slab_compact aggressiveness from 0.6 -> 0.5 on ga-3-12 and watch for CPU/IO impact. Also will run heap profile: `./bin/heap_diagnostic --node ga-3-12 --out /tmp/heap-2840123.pb`
sara-support: I'll send the customer a temporary workaround: reduce context + stagger their bursts. Include ETA for more concrete fix?
oncall-bot: @alex-sre assigned incident INC-28401 to on-call. Priority P2.
ops-bot: Action log: increased autoscale target for ga-3 by +2 nodes (policy override) at 08:52 PST. Watch for cooldown effects.
alex-sre: Update after canary (09:05): compaction tweak reduced eviction-rate to ~120/s and latency improved, but IO spiked on node for ~30s. Need more testing to ensure compaction doesn't thrash.
mike-ml: Long-term fixes we should consider: tenant-shaped slab sizing (allocate slabs based on recent median context length), KV slab defragmenter that runs off-peak, and better KV key normalization for long prompts.
tian-account: I'll tell GarageLabs we have a mitigation and are doing a targeted config change; offer a one-week credits review depending on root cause.
ingrid-runtime: Repro steps for eng to validate locally:
1) run customer repro against staging pool (use dedicated-sim image)
2) collect `kvcache stats --json` every 10s
3) run `perf top` and `iostat` during compaction window
4) upload heap dump to /shared/debug/INC-28401

Example `kvcache stats` snippet we captured:
```
{"tenant":"garagelabs","evict_rate":472,"entries":642312,"avg_entry_size":1248,"frag_ratio":0.34}
```
alex-sre: I'll take steps 1-3 on staging and report back in 30m. If results match, next actions: schedule a rolling compaction and update autoscale policy to be more sensitive to evict_rate.
sara-support: Thanks team — told customer: workaround + we're on it, ETA 45m for follow-up. Will escalate billing after eng confirms root cause. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: INC-28401 status updated: investigating -> mitigated (partial).
alex-sre: Final note — if we can't stabilise with compaction, fallback plan is to failover tenant to a larger Dedicated pool (manual) while we implement slab/defrag improvements.
sara-support: Closing loop with customer now. Will reopen if we see recurrence.
